SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26004530
DOCKET NO. F00604525
PLAINTIFF – FREEDOM MORTGAGE CORPORATION
DEFENDANTS- MARILYN C. FERRIS; ET. AL.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 1st DAY OF December 2026
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of EAST ORANGE, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
LOT: 20 BLOCK: 841
DIMENSIONS (APPROX.) 50 FEET BY 193 FEET
UPSET BID AMOUNT: $267,703.96
OCCUPANCY STATUS: OWNER OCCUPIED
AMOUNT DUE FOR TAXES: TAXES PAID AND CURRENT AS OF 09/23/2026. SALE MAY BE SUBJECT TO SUBSEQUENT TAXES, LIENS, UTILITIES AND INTEREST SINCE 09/23/2026. WATER/SEWER PAID AND CURRENT AS OF 09/23/2026.
SUBJECT TO: ALL UNPAID MUNICIPAL TAXES, ASSESSMENTS, LIENS AND OTHER CHARGES; ANY SET OF FACTS WHICH AN ACCURATE SURVEY WOULD DISCLOSE; ANY RESTRICTIONS OR COVENANTS ON RECORD WHICH RUN WITH THE LAND; RIGHTS OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, IF ANY; ANY CONDOMINIUN LIEN PRIORITY PURSUANT TO NJSA 46:88-21, IF ANY; ANY OUSTANDING PUD OR HOMEOWNER'S ASSOCIATIONS DUES OR FEES, IF ANY; ANY OCCUPANTS OR PERSONS IN POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY, IF ANY; ADDITIONAL MUNICIPAL CHARGES, LIENS, TAXES OR TAX SALE CERTIFICATES AND INSURANCE, IF ANY; AND ANY SUCH TAXES, MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCE PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS SALE. THE AMOUNT OF UNPAID TAXES, MUNICIPAL LIENS AND OTHER CHARGES CAN BE OBTAINED FROM THE LOCAL TAXING AUTHORITY. ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEIN FORECLOSED AND, IF SO, THE CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON. IF THE SALE IS SET ASIDE FOR ANY REASON, THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY A RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE AGAINST THE MORTGAGOR, MORTGAGEE OR THE MORTGAGEE'S ATTORNEY.
AS THE ABOVE DESCRIPTION DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION, SAID FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION IS ANNEXED TO THAT CERTAIN MORTGAGE RECORDED IN THE ESSEX COUNTY REGISTER'S OFFICE IN INSTRUMENT NUMBER: 2017092986, ET SEQ. NEW JERSEY, AND THE WRIT OF EXECUTION ON FILE WITH THE SHERIFF OF ESSEX COUNTY.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
34-36 LINWOOD PL EAST ORANGE, NJ 07017
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $263,274.35 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: October 21, 2026
GROSS POLOWY LLC
1775 WEHRLE DR
SUITE 100
WILLIAMSVILLE, NY 14221
7163628012
